Utonia.mode: official original modules, reduced configuration, no pretrained weights

SPoTr.paper: CVPR2023 Self-positioning Point-based Transformer for Point Cloud Understanding
SPoTr.module: LPAMLP (entire original constructor/forward), new_attention, get_aggregation_features, original conv/activation factories
SPoTr.adaptation: original within-patch bipartite raw grouping; original mass and padding logit prior; no normalization; one post-conv; no global SPoTr path; unused official alpha frozen

path_message.query: observed skeleton region LayerNorm plus shared learned constant

constant_message.change: identical gated-message parameters and geometry; no observed graph content in NEW query
constant_message.query: shared learned constant; graph still used by original R28

ordinary_attention.change: R17 four-head centered-value attention with geometry logits and mass prior; R28 patch input
ordinary_attention.source: official GeoTransformer-derived R17 adapter; not equal capacity to gated message

geometry: original five-dimensional phi only; no extra geometry or support
initialization: new output zero, inherited R28 parameters/RNG unchanged
new_surface_addition: after inherited shared physical code, before original region joint
objective: inherited H01 losses; same labels, budget, orders, engineering and all-parent gradients
no_leakage_scope: original train/dev cell-disjoint manifest; only input geometry, no target fields passed; development repeatedly used, not independent holdout
